title: Neuroscience-Inspired Artificial Intelligence
evidence_note: Advocates computational and algorithmic inspiration while allowing implementations to depart from biological detail.
limitation: Scholarly perspective with historical examples; not evidence that a particular agent filing system improves accuracy.
review_level: selected full-text introduction, memory sections, and transfer discussion

title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
evidence_note: LLM-extracted graph and query-seeded Personalized PageRank support passage retrieval; evaluates bounded multi-hop QA.
limitation: Extraction and graph-search errors, entity/context tradeoff, and unvalidated larger-scale behavior; no biological equivalence or task-continuation test.
review_level: selected full-text methodology, experimental setup, limitations, and appendix error analysis

title: From RAG to Memory: Non-Parametric Continual Learning for Large Language Models
venue_or_status: ICML 2025, PMLR 267; selected arXiv v2 full text also inspected
evidence_note: Combines passage/phrase graph nodes, query-to-triple matching and LLM filtering; compares factual, discourse and associative QA.
limitation: Tested reader/corpus configurations and human-memory-inspired task labels do not establish faithful neural simulation or reliable filesystem continuation.
review_level: official proceedings metadata plus selected full-text arXiv v2 methods, evaluations, ablations and error analysis
